target: Azoth session-closeout routing after dynamic-full-auto implementation packaging
summary: After a dynamic-full-auto implementation run completed cleanly, closeout was not immediately safe because the run ledger and scope gate reflected the completed derived-capsule helper session while .azoth/session-state.md still pointed at an older exploratory Phase 4 session.
evidence: The 2026-05-01 planning-banks derived task-capsule helper run completed with no active run, no write claim, paired stage evidence, and a closed scope gate for session 2026-05-01-planning-banks-derived-capsule-helper. However, before closeout, .azoth/session-state.md still named session 2026-05-01-adhoc-start-phase-4-for-the-codex-profile-split-work-i as active exploratory state. Because scripts/do_closeout.py infers session context from live .azoth state and has no --session-id flag, running closeout immediately risked closing or entangling the wrong lifecycle state. The operator had to approve a manual split: package implementation first, then capture and repair lifecycle bookkeeping separately.
recommended_action: Add or route through a first-class session lifecycle resolver before session-closeout. It should compare scope-gate, run-ledger, session-state, and session registry, then either select the completed delivery session explicitly, soft-stop as already closed, or block with a precise repair instruction. A closeout command should not infer from stale exploratory session-state when the just-completed run ledger names a different completed implementation session.
